question: PV Sindhu won a bronze medal in May 2022 in which of the following badminton tournaments ?
solution:
The correct answer is **Badminton Asia Championships 2022**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Badminton Asia Championships 2022**

 
 
• **Sindhu** won the **bronze medal**, her second medal at the competition, at the **2022 Badminton Asia Championships**, in which she was **ranked fourth**.
